answer_1.quote: We evaluated two open-ended benchmarks spanning short-answer and long-answer generation, including TruthfulQA, and LongFact... We also evaluated chain-of-thought reasoning benchmarks StrategyQA and GSM8K, and a domain-specific software package hallucination benchmark.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for QA, long-form factual texts, chain-of-thought reasoning steps, and lists of software packages.

answer_2.quote: We use GPT-4o-mini to evaluate the truthfulness (Truth), and informativeness (Info) of each generated answer... The adopted metrics include the proportion of truthful facts (Precision), Recall@128, F1@128, accuracy on StrategyQA and GSM8K, and hallucination rate (%Hallu).

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o-mini to evaluate the truthfulness (Truth), and informativeness (Info) of each generated answer... GPT-4o-mini is also used to extract atomic facts and evaluate factuality.
